north.evidence: Pokharia et al. 2017 S1 Fig: a four-pointed compass star below the letter 'N' at the upper right; no legend or text giving its meaning. Measured from the tip of the south point to the tip of the north point.

scale.note: 'SCALE IN METRES' bar with blurred labels; the bar has one subdivided unit left of the second label and four equal units right of it, read as 10 5 0 10 20 30 40; lengths carry this reading.

lines.identification: centre of the straight bundle of contour lines along the west side of the fortified area ('Gadh Wali Wadi'), which the plan draws only as contours of the rampart mound; manual picks of the bundle centre at both ends; Pokharia et al. 2017, PLOS ONE 12(10): e0185684, S1 Fig 'The contour map of the excavation plan at Khirsara archaeological site' (downloaded TIFF, SHA-256 b87fcd36...0cc5f).
